name: Santorini (Thira) Airport

hours.v: airport open every day 05:45-22:45 local; terminal 04:00-23:00; may be extended on specific dates for individual flights

slots.v: winter 2026/27: not coordinated (Level 1); summer 2027: coordinated (Level 3); GA/BA flights get slot allocation in summer

also.quote: | 10 | JTR | LGSR | THIRA | Coordinated (Level 3) | Υes | Data collection by airport (Level 1) |

ppr.v: GA/BA flights must obtain a parking authorisation number (PPR for apron clearance) from the operator
ppr.quote: to obtain a parking authorization number (PPR - Prior Permission Required for Apron Clearance)

handling.v: all PPR requests go through a ground handler holding an HCAA category 1 licence
handling.quote: All PPR requests must be cleared through a Ground Handling Service Provider with a valid category 1 License by HCAA

notes: No AIP page could be read (Greek eAIP AD 2 LGSR not found). Hours conflict on the operator's own site: the Airport information page and site footer show airport 'Every Day 05:45 – 22:45' and terminal 'Every Day 04:00 – 23:00' (recorded, no dates shown; probably winter 2026/27), while the GA page still shows 'Every Day 00:00 – 23:59'. Outside the hours is not recorded as a curfew because no source calls it one; check before any early or late slot. HSCA operating-hours PDF JTROPHRS.pdf read: S26 only (14 Sep to 24 Oct 2026, 00:00-23:59 UTC), expired. Fraport Greece W26 runway operating hours PDF (Version 2) refused by proxy (URL too long); PPR Handbook v11 PDF blocked (permission not answered), so lead time and ground-time rules are not recorded.
